characters.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE standalone character mascot for a Japanese face-preference quiz, used on result screens and social cards.
Primary request: Create an original, clearly stylized adult human character, not a real-looking face or a portrait photo. A coherent collectible family of flat editorial characters: 3.5-head-tall body proportions, oversized simplified head, small almond or dot eyes, minimal nose, tiny closed-mouth smile. Crisp geometric shapes, subtly faceted hair and clothing, restrained warm colors, slightly irregular hand-cut paper feeling, no heavy outlines, no realistic skin texture. Readable silhouette at small thumbnail size. Sophisticated and friendly rather than babyish. An original identity, not an existing branded character.
Composition: square image, one full-body character standing in a relaxed three-quarter pose, both feet and the whole hairstyle inside the frame with 12% breathing room. Body facing mostly forward; face readable. Simple hands by the body. Consistent 3.5-head proportions. Plain unbranded modern everyday clothing. One subtle graphic accent beside the character is allowed, but no scene or detailed props.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background. No ground rectangle, no opaque background, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
The character represents a preferred visual impression, not a personality, job, hierarchy, attractiveness rating or age category. All characters are stylized adults of similar age. No sexualized styling. No medical or fortune-telling symbols.
